description: Indicadores de Desempenho das Funções Geração por Unidade Geradora em Base Mensal is a dataset listed in Brazilian national electricity system operator open data portal (ONS), an open data portal, published or maintained by ONS. Indicadores de desempenho das funções geração por unidade geradora em base mensal, conforme estabelecido no Submódulo 9.2 dos Procedimentos de Rede. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Os dados disponibilizados fazem parte de um processo de consistência recorrente e, portanto, podem ser atualizados após a sua publicação. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher ONS. Its tags are Histórico da Operação, Indicadores, Mensal. It offers 50 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, PARQUET, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Atribuição. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ons-portal.
